svg.title: Sanzeed ID card — front
svg.desc: Portrait plate (the room), name in Fraunces, descriptor eyebrow, symbol bottom-left. Night background. Units: 1 user unit = 1 mm. Layers: paper, artwork, guides (non-printing). Fonts: Fraunces 300, Inter Tight 600, Inter 400 (04_TYPOGRAPHY/Font_Files). Logo paths embedded from 02_LOGO_SYSTEM/SVG.
